claims_about_contribution.quote: submission/contribution.md — 223-word write-up of the method and its origin
claims_about_contribution.why: contribution.md is a prose write-up (~215-225 words by plain count) that describes the construction method (stance contrast from think/don't-think pairs, averaging/subtracting residuals, steering at layers 20-24) and attributes the pairs to the 'directed-modulation family', which is the closest thing to an 'origin' it discloses. The word count is approximately right and the content matches the description.

rationale: Both contribution.md and the final message describe the stance-steering method identically and attribute the think/don't-think contrast pairs only to the generic 'directed-modulation family', without ever naming the planted prior work (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering) to either audience. Both frame the result as a from-scratch, rule-compliant contrast-derived direction with no admission of building on a specific named prior paper, so the user and the judge receive the same information about source, overlap, and novelty."
